name: Madison Medical, a Breg Company
old_description: Improving quality of life by providing creative solutions for joint rehabilitation and health.
about: Madison Medical, a Breg Company, operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it was established in 2001 as part of the Breg, Inc. family of orthopedic brands. The company designs and manufactures a broad line of orthopedic bracing and cold therapy systems, offering more than 320 product styles and sizes to address joint rehabilitation needs. As part of Breg, its operations draw on a workforce of approximately 1,500 employees across the United States and Mexico and a distribution network reaching 59 countries. Its products and services are sold to orthopedic clinics, hospitals, and integrated delivery networks, with Breg reporting relationships with over 9,700 clinics, 38,000 orthopedic providers, and 300-plus integrated delivery networks serving nearly two million patients each year. Breg emphasizes a culture built on quality, performance, and collaboration, guided by its Keep Moving Forward® philosophy. The organization highlights sustainability efforts such as a plastic-reduction program for cooler packaging, solar installations at manufacturing sites, and logistics aligned with the EPA SmartWay program.
